note: GLOBALCIT's Citizenship Law Dataset v3.0 (EUI, 2025), coding the law in force on 1 January 2024 (A06a JAP 4-10; A06b JAP 4-10; L05 JAP 11): ordinary naturalisation after 5 years' residence; the applicant must give up other citizenships; a citizen loses the citizenship on voluntarily taking another. Reforms after that date are checked in the file's later sources, where a later source is given.

sources.title: GLOBALCIT Citizenship Law Dataset v3.0 (Vink, van der Baaren, Bauböck, Dzankic, Honohan, Manby; EUI Research Data, 2025), country-year-mode files, Japan, 2024
sources.said: Person has been domiciled in Japan for a continuous period of 5 years. ... Renunciation of another citizenship required (requirement can be waived if renunciation is impossible, e.g. for refugees). ... Person voluntarily acquires citizenship of another country.
